descriptions.d29d_turn_manager_message_80154f64: Turn manager message handler. Message 64 runs the base handler and then the setup at 0x80156ff0, returning 0x80004005 if the base failed; message 66 runs the shutdown. Otherwise tests the cached message ids in turn and dispatches to worm and team publishing, surrender, death, reinitialise, respawn, position and nearest-enemy selection, movement retain and release, and actor creation, with trace calls; falls through to the base handler.
